rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1997).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 1997 as 'Caprice de Meilland'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Strong, fruity fragrance. Average diameter 4.75". Very large bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy. Matte, light green foliage.

Height: 31" to 39" (80 to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Heat tolerant. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood.. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
